purpose: Network shooter prototype: one playable floor with a 3 by 3 grid of rooms, clear routes, office facade windows and non-damaging shooting.
runtimeSurface: Browser WebGL client plus Node.js WebSocket LAN lobby; authored source is Blender.

exceptions: The ramp occupies the north side room to establish a reliable vertical route.

circulation.description: The level is one 3 by 3 grid. Central room opens to all four side rooms; every side room opens to its two adjacent corners through 2.5m apertures. The north room contains a 2.4m ceiling hatch with a ladder fixed to its left edge; it leads to the roof.
